add context and echo 'current context wher script is running is 'string' NAMESPACE=inventory-dev
NEW\_NAMESPACE=inventory-gke-dev

# Initialize the secrets\_rename\_test.yaml file with an empty list
echo "apiVersion: v1" > secrets\_rename\_test.yaml
echo "kind: List" >> secrets\_rename\_test.yaml
echo "items:" >> secrets\_rename\_test.yaml

# Loop through every secret in the namespace and append it to the secrets\_rename\_test.yaml file
for SECRET\_NAME in $(kubectl get secrets -n $NAMESPACE -o=jsonpath='{.items[\*].metadata.name}'); do
 SECRET=$(kubectl get secret -n $NAMESPACE $SECRET\_NAME -o yaml | sed "s/namespace: $NAMESPACE/namespace: $NEW\_NAMESPACE/g")
 echo "$SECRET" >> secrets\_rename\_test.yaml
 echo "Secret $SECRET\_NAME namespace changed to $NEW\_NAMESPACE"
done

# Print the contents of secrets\_rename\_test.yaml
cat secrets\_rename\_test.yaml
